name: pkgstate
description: Laptop package state manager — TUI for inventorying every package across every package manager.

scripts.lint: bunx biome check src/ test/ bench/
scripts.lint:fix: bunx biome check --write src/ test/ bench/
scripts.format: bunx biome format --write src/ test/ bench/
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun test
scripts.build:all: bun build --compile --minify --sourcemap --target=bun-linux-x64 src/cli.ts --outfile=dist/pkgstate-linux-x64 && bun build --compile --minify --sourcemap --target=bun-linux-arm64 src/cli.ts --outfile=dist/pkgstate-linux-arm64 && bun build --compile --minify --sourcemap --target=bun-darwin-x64 src/cli.ts --outfile=dist/pkgstate-darwin-x64 && bun build --compile --minify --sourcemap --target=bun-darwin-arm64 src/cli.ts --outfile=dist/pkgstate-darwin-arm64
